facts.fact: The Secretary of State for the Digital Economy said a national strategy of skills and digital readiness, part of the World Bank-funded Digital Cabo Verde project, is being prepared after a workshop in Praia.
facts.system: National strategy of skills and digital readiness

facts.fact: The Cabo Verde government launched the Skodji Digital programme to train up to 3,000 young people in digital skills, with 1,050 participants in the first phase and applications open to 25 February.

note: A strategy axis on digital competences with a digital-literacy indicator; no programme or measured share stated.

facts.fact: Resolução 72/2026 recognises as progress digital-inclusion and skills-training initiatives developed for citizens and public servants.

systems.system: Code the Future – Cabo Verde Rising

note: Only a coding and AI course for 500 high school students and teachers, run by SheCode.ai; no public digital-skills programme or measured skills share stated.
The charter is declaratory and non-binding and only commits members to promote digital literacy policies; no programme for the country is stated.

facts.fact: The document says the World Bank-financed Digital Cabo Verde Project supports WebLab Phase II to train youth and women in digital skills (coding, robotics), aiming to certify 25,000 youth with 50% female participation.

note: Only a suspended school lab project and a vague promise of new digital literacy measures; no public programme delivered or skills share.

facts.fact: The ARME chair says the regulator ARME has been carrying out many digital literacy actions, notably in schools, and a mentoring session on digital literacy for 60 girls from 10 Praia lyceums was set for 22-23 April 2026.

note: A pilot digital-skills course for public servants, 22-26 September 2025; nothing on skills for the public.
Only a call for digital literacy; no programme or survey stated.
Programme is for public servants only.
Reports a mean skills score (3.75 of 6), not a share with basic digital skills; no programme stated.

facts.fact: Cabo Verde's digital economy and education ministries opened a 15-station TechLab in Brava in April 2026 as a national pilot under the Skodji Digital programme and National Digital Literacy Programme, within a plan to expand the network, with no number trained stated.

systems.owner: Ministry of Digital Economy with Ministry of Education

note: An opposition party's statement; no public digital-skills programme or measured share stated.
Mentions spaces for digital skills training only in passing; no programme, count or measured share.
No programme teaching the public digital skills is stated; training for users is only to follow the launch.

facts.fact: Cabo Verde's education ministry, through its higher-education director-general Odair Varela, announced the creation of a national programme of education for citizenship and digital safety in schools for 2027/2031, with digital literacy and responsible AI use among five priorities.
facts.system: Programa Nacional de Educação para Cidadania e Segurança Digital
